style: Match the attached approved kingfisher reference ONLY for naturalistic watercolor and fine coloured-pencil rendering, detailed feather texture and restrained field-guide lighting. Replace the kingfisher completely with the specified species. Do not copy its blue/orange colours, proportions, facing or props. Output one new original bird illustration, never a panel or montage. No text, labels, logos, shadow, checkerboard or paper rectangle. Real transparent alpha background. No anatomy inventions: exactly two wings/flippers in total (far folded wing can be hidden), one head and one bill, correct feet/toes. An open wing replaces its folded outline on that side; never add an extra folded wing.

primary.direction: PRIMARY compact portrait: whole bird in a natural resting/standing upright posture facing RIGHT. Closed wings (relaxed flippers for penguin), natural visible feet, beak/tail/toes fully inside image, bird occupies about 85% of canvas. Bird ONLY: no branch, perch, rock, ground, plants, water, food or shadow. Not flying, not crouching. Use a species-appropriate natural body carriage; a duck and penguin need not sit like a songbird.

dynamic.direction: DYNAMIC species-page hero: distinct species-specific behavior/vignette as described below. Large bird, centered slightly left with ample room in front of its bill, about 80-90% of available frame. Natural minimal habitat accents only; genuine alpha transparency around scene. All heads, bills and bird parts inside master image; the app may bleed the sides. No hard crop along the TOP: branches/trunks must end naturally or fade transparently before the top edge. Avoid excessive empty top/right space and avoid a beige paper background copied from the reference.

targets.fieldMarks: Plain pale grey-brown crown and face with only subtle tonal differences and a weak pale eyebrow. No bold black or white head stripes. Small pale yellow patch/short narrow streak on the lower throat ONLY; upper throat and belly pale buff-grey/off-white, never a yellow bib or yellow belly. Chestnut shoulder patch, two pale wing bars, short conical dark bill.
targets.dynamicScene: Resting on a small naturally ending dry twig, wings both folded.
targets.correction: Correct the exaggerated head contrast and excessive yellow. Restrict yellow strictly to a small lower-throat mark.
